issue.title: CSV import rejects BOM
issue.body: A valid UTF-8 CSV beginning with a byte-order mark fails header validation.

candidates.title: CSV export quoting
candidates.body: Exports need to quote fields containing commas.

candidates.title: CSV empty file
candidates.body: An empty CSV file raises a different exception before parsing headers.

candidates.title: UTF-8 BOM breaks header detection
candidates.body: Import treats the UTF-8 BOM as part of the first header and rejects a valid CSV.
